title: Margherita Pizza
ingredients: pizza dough; tomato sauce; fresh mozzarella; basil; olive oil; salt
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 500F with a pizza stone inside. 2. Stretch the dough into a 12-inch round. 3. Spread tomato sauce, tear mozzarella over top. 4. Bake 8-10 min until crust is charred in spots. 5. Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.
